Athletics for Everyone! 

All kids aged 7–14 are welcome at Ngā Puna Wai Athletics Track. No experience required!

📅 Starts Sunday 25 October
⏰ 2:00–3:00pm
📍 Ngā Puna Wai Athletics Track
💰 $5 per session or $25 for 6 sessions

The programme runs through Term 4 and continues into Term 1.

Register via the link: https://forms.cloud.microsoft/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=ZgaZvm_VaUC1OGDtOJJgn6VUdh5srt9NqBumf3kgjZFUN05GV01RMDFMVDgwQ1FSVjRSQkJTQkg2Qi4u&fbclid=IwY2xjawUyUIJleHRuA2FlbQIxMABwZG9mAWJyaWQRMXRsa0dST0gxeEtZYjdjTnpzcnRjBmFwcF9pZBAyMjIwMzkxNzg4MjAwODkyAAEeyD-vPDt7Xpg32JWjgR_U7SQkCmoK5k0fiHR8eaDF3wW9v2C8flBNh8FB234_aem_cS1W6ulDnvopLMlD7-ej4Q

or email Chloe.Roberts@athleticscanterbury.org.nz
Come along, have a go and give athletics a try!

text:
Tonight is our first of two North Canterbury Children's Athletics open days.  Following the children's training, is our open athletics training sessions for new and returning high school, senior and masters athletes kicking off at 6:00pm.  

Canterbury Interclub competition starts 17th October, Secondary Schools Champs on 5th December, Oceania Masters in late January, there is something for everyone.  Pop down from 6pm, introduce yourself to our coaches and check it out.
